brownout: Working with a feature switched off
One file in, pictures out. Three groups are folded away.
The vocabulary: states, kinds, shapes and packs, merged before the author's own.
Packs, two levels down: the providers' icon sets as kinds, sre as states.
The runtime, inlined into every interactive file: camera, session, morph.
A mistake in the file: the validator answers, nothing renders.
Fixed at the pointer. Everything flows again.
What is next: explain, in the author's words.
